application: Application: Your protocol's name, describing what it does.
chat_welcome_message:
How can I assist you today?
I can help you:
- Generate protocols for your experiments
- Simulate your protocols
- Answer questions about the Opentrons API v2

Let's get started!
commands: Commands: List the protocol's steps, specifying quantities in microliters (uL) and giving exact source and destination locations.
disclaimer: OpentronsAI can make mistakes. Review your protocol before running it on an Opentrons robot.
drag_and_drop: Drag and drop or browse your files
error_connection: Could not reach the AI service.
error_context_length: Your request is too large for the AI to process. Try removing attached files or shortening your message.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_rate_limit: The AI is currently busy. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_timeout: The request exceeded 3 minutes. Please simplify your request and try again.
example: For example prompts, click the buttons in the left panel.
exit_confirmation_body: Exiting now will discard your progress.
exit_confirmation_title: Are you sure you want to exit?
file_length_error: The length of the file contents is 0. Please upload a file with content.
got_feedback: Got feedback? We love to hear it.
key_info: Here are some key pieces of information to provide in your prompt:
labware_and_tipracks: Labware and tip racks: Use names from the Opentrons Labware Library.
landing_page_body: Get started building a prompt that will generate a Python protocol that you can use on your Opentrons robot. OpentronsAI lets you create and optimize your protocol by responding in natural language.
landing_page_body_mobile: Use a desktop browser to use OpentronsAI.
landing_page_body_new: Get started creating and optimizing protocols for your Opentrons robot.
landing_page_chat_description: Head directly to OpentronsAI chat to ask a question or paste an existing prompt
landing_page_create_description: Go through our wizard to create a new protocol from scratch
landing_page_update_description: Upload your existing protocol and explain what you'd like to change
liquid_locations: Liquid locations: Describe where liquids should go in the labware.
make_sure_your_prompt: Write a prompt in a natural language for OpentronsAI to generate a protocol using the Opentrons Python Protocol API v2. The better the prompt, the better the quality of the protocol produced by OpentronsAI.
manage_feature_flags_description: Configure experimental features and prerelease functionality
modules_and_adapters: Modules and adapters: Specify the modules and labware adapters required by your protocol.
notes: A few important things to note:
ot2_pipettes: OT-2 pipettes: Include volume, number of channels, and generation.
pd_protocol_reply: Here’s the protocol I generated for you. You can download it and import it to Protocol Designer
pipettes: Pipettes: Specify your pipettes, including the volume, number of channels, and whether they’re mounted on the left or right.
privacy_policy: By continuing, you agree to the Opentrons <privacyPolicyLink>Privacy policy</privacyPolicyLink> and <EULALink>End user license agreement</EULALink>
prompt_preview_placeholder_message: As you complete the sections on the left, your prompt will be built here. When all requirements are met you will be able to generate the protocol.
provide_details_of_changes: Provide details of changes you want to make
reload_page: To start over and create a new protocol, simply reload the page.
robot_type: Robot type: Choose the OT-2 or Opentrons Flex.
send_feedback_input_title: Share why the response was not helpful
share_analytics_description: Help Opentrons improve its products and services by automatically sending anonymous diagnostics and usage data
side_panel_body: Write a prompt in natural language to generate a Reagent Transfer or a PCR protocol for the OT-2 or Opentrons Flex using the Opentrons Python Protocol API.
side_panel_header: Use natural language to generate protocols with OpentronsAI powered by OpenAI
simulate_description: Once OpentronsAI has written your protocol, type `simulate` in the prompt box to try it out.
try_example_prompts: Stuck? Try these example prompts to get started.
update_option_adapt_python_protocol: Adapt Python protocol from OT-2 to Flex
